mapper.select: SELECT f.*,(SELECT count(*) FROM nw_foundation_file_references r WHERE r.file_id=f.id) reference_count FROM nw_foundation_files f WHERE f.id=#{id} AND f.scope_key= FOR UPDATE OF f

SELECT f.*,(SELECT count(*) FROM nw_foundation_file_references r WHERE r.file_id=f.id) reference_count FROM nw_foundation_files f WHERE f.state='ready' AND source_kind='upload' AND f.scope_key= ORDER BY f.created_at DESC,f.id DESC OFFSET #{offset} LIMIT #{size}
SELECT count(*) FROM nw_foundation_files WHERE state='ready' AND source_kind='upload' AND scope_key=
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_foundation_file_references(file_id,scope_key,owner_kind,owner_id) SELECT id,scope_key,#{kind},#{owner} FROM nw_foundation_files WHERE id=#{id} AND state='ready' AND scope_key= ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM nw_foundation_file_references WHERE file_id=#{id} AND owner_kind=#{kind} AND owner_id=#{owner} AND scope_key=
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_foundation_files f SET state='deleting',updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND state='ready' AND f.scope_key= AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_file_references r WHERE r.file_id=f.id)
UPDATE nw_foundation_files SET state='deleted',updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND state='deleting' AND scope_key=
mapper.select: SELECT f.* FROM nw_foundation_files f WHERE current_setting('app.foundation_maintenance',true)='true' AND (state='deleting' OR (state='ready' AND created_at < #{olderThan} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_file_references r WHERE r.file_id=f.id))) ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT #{size}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_foundation_files WHERE id=#{id} AND current_setting('app.foundation_maintenance',true)='true')
SELECT owner_kind "ownerKind",owner_id "ownerId" FROM nw_foundation_file_references WHERE file_id=#{id} AND scope_key= ORDER BY owner_kind,owner_id
